newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberdrola 1996 net profit rises 13.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Iberdrola 1996 net profit rises 13.3 pct.

text.p: Results for Spanish utility Iberdrola for 1996 (in billions of pesetas, unless stated):
NOTE - The company said in a statement that group debt now represented 32.7 percent of assets compared with 48.6 percent in 1995.
Financial costs fell almost 28 percent due to the reduction in debt and its lower average cost.
The company said an 8.7 percent fall in supply costs and a fall in real terms in personnel and external service costs helped boost operating profit.

Fixed-asset investment rose to 81.9 billion pesetas of which 47 percent was directed toward expansion, modernisation and improvement in the distribution network, 36 percent to generation and 17 percent to nuclear fuel and other tangible fixed assets.
